notes.title: Eggsplosion is now Steam Deck Verified and major 2vs2 improvements!
notes.content:
Hey all,
We have just pushed out a big update that sees the game get verified on Deck as well as some big fixes!

Included in this update:
[list]
[*] Several major improvements to reach Deck Verified status!
[i]Most of these are to do with controller input and glyphs[/i]
[*] Improvements for Steam account images on the leaderboard
[*] Resolved a major issue for the two vs two gamemodes where players were unable to interact with the powerup selection menu.
[*] Added additional check to see if there are four players when attempting to start a game in two vs two.
[/list]

To come in the future:
[list]
[*] More achievements! (if you have any ideas, let us know!)
[*] New and improved leaderboard UI
[/list]

We will keep working hard to bring you the best eggxperience possible, in the mean time. Let us know what you think and what you would like to see coming to the game in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469370

notes.title: Better controller interaction and casual game quit fix
notes.content:
Hey all,

We have just pushed out an update that brings controller improvements as well as fixing a critical issue for quitting the game.

Included in this update:
[list]
[*] Bug fix where you were unable to click 'quit' in the result screen within the casual gamemode.
[*] Improved the controller prompt detection, this should hopefully mean the images don't glitch out anymore.
[*] Added a disconnect check for controllers. From now on, if a controller disconnects while in-game, the options menu will be brought up and the game will be paused.
[/list]

We will keep working hard to bring you the best eggxperience possible, in the mean time. Let us know what you think and what you would like to see coming to the game in the future!

notes.title: New and improved sound effects and leaderboard UI fix
notes.content:
Hey all,

We have just pushed out an update that brings new sound effects for various things as well as improving the music currently in the game.

Included in this update:

[list]
[*] New sound effects for the following:
Throwing, Dashing, Dying, Freeze Powerup and lastly the Rapid Fire Powerup
[*] The music has been increased in pitch
[*] The leaderboard UI now continues working after playing a game
[*] The continue button in the pause menu works in every situation again
[/list]

To come in the future:
[list]
[*] Button prompts switching when the mouse was used

[/list]

notes.title: New and improved UI and fix for game not starting
notes.content:
Hey all,

After some difficulties we have now fixed a big problem some of you may have encountered, as well as some UI improvements!

Included in this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where you would quit a game through the in-game pause menu, which would result in being unable to play another match without restarting the whole game
[*] Added new UI for the in-game options menu and the options screen in the main menu. Let us know what you think of it!
[*] Fixed the sizing of the confirmation prompt when you want to quit the game
[*] Several minor bugfixes
[/list]

To come in the future:
[list]
[*] Button prompts switching when the mouse was used
[*] New and improved leaderboard UI
[*] More achievements!
[/list]

We will keep working hard to bring you the best eggxperience possible, in the mean time. Let us know what you think and what you would like to see coming to the game in the future!

notes.title: Casual mode scoring and persistent audio fix
notes.content:
Hey all,

This time around we have added scoring for the casual gamemode as well as several bug fixes and improvements!

Included in this update:

[list]
[*] Added proper scoring for casual mode ! (you can now see how many kills you earned during the round)
[*] Fixed some UI bugs
[*] Fixed a bug where the in-game audio persisted when going back to main menu
[*] Made progress saving for achievements and leaderboards more consistent
[*] Several minor bugfixes
[/list]

We will keep working hard to bring you the best eggxperience possible, in the mean time. Let us know what you think and what you would like to see coming to the game in the future!
